Referring to the object specified in question 5(a) with overall dimensions $150\text{ mm} \times 60\text{ mm} \times 40\text{ mm}$:

1. **Top View (TV):**
   - Align vertically below the Front View.
   - Draw a rectangle of $150\text{ mm} \times 60\text{ mm}.
   - Draw the two rectangular cutouts of size $20\text{ mm} \times 15\text{ mm}$ located at the respective wings at a distance of $15\text{ mm}$ from the edges.
   - Represent the central rib of width $20\text{ mm}$ spanning the $60\text{ mm}$ depth using solid and hidden lines where appropriate.
2. **Side View (Looking from Right):**
   - Place to the left of the Front View (assuming First Angle Projection).
   - Draw an L-shaped or T-shaped profile of width $60\text{ mm}$ and height $40\text{ mm}$.
   - Show the base thickness of $10\text{ mm}$ and the vertical rib rising up to $40\text{ mm}$ with a thickness of $20\text{ mm}$.
   - Include hidden dashed lines for any obscured slots or internal changes in section.
proTip: Double-check slot locations and symmetry dimensions from the isometric pictorial before drawing top and side views.
